description: This PHP source file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'EmployeeTrackerSearchFilterParams' within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for filtering employee tracker data in the Performance module. It extends a base 'FilterParams' class and includes properties, constants, and methods for managing filtering and sorting parameters related to employee tracking.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for filtering employee tracker search results, allowing specification of tracker IDs, employee number, and inclusion filters, with default sorting set to 'tracker.modifiedDate' in descending order.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field 'tracker.modifiedDate' and sort order descending.

methods.name: getTrackerIds
methods.description: Returns the array of tracker IDs to filter by, or null if not set.

methods.name: setTrackerIds
methods.description: Sets the tracker IDs for filtering.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter, or null if not set.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves the current include employees filter (e.g., 'onlyCurrent', 'onlyPast', 'currentAndPast').
